title: Eventual flatness at a contracted prime of a supplied approximation
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings and let R to S be a ring map. Let M be an S-module. Let Λ be a nonempty directed preorder and let A,B:Λ to CommRing and D:Λ to AddCommGrp be functors [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give D_i a B_i-module structure for every i. Suppose η:A to B, π:A to const(R), κ:B to const(S), and ν:D to const(M) are natural transformations. Assume R,S,M with these coprojections are colimits, η_i followed by κ_i equals π_i followed by R to S, every D transition is semilinear with respect to its B transition, and ν_i(bx)=κ_i(b)ν_i(x). Suppose each A_i is a finite-type integer algebra and each B_i is finite type over A_i [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], with D_i finite over B_i [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. For i≤j assume a ring isomorphism B_i tensor_(A_i) A_j to B_j sending b tensor a to B(i≤j)(b)η_j(a), and a B_j-linear isomorphism B_j tensor_(B_i) D_i to D_j sending b tensor x to b D(i≤j)(x). At each i suppose also a ring isomorphism B_i tensor_(A_i) R to S sending b tensor r to κ_i(b)r, and an S-linear isomorphism S tensor_(B_i) D_i to M sending s tensor x to sν_i(x). The algebra structures in these tensors are induced by η, π, κ and the transitions. If M, restricted along R to S, is flat over R [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then for every prime q of S there is an index i such that D_i localized at the contracted prime κ_i^(-1)(q) is flat over A_i, with its A_i-action restricted through η_i. This claims neither openness nor persistence of a flat locus, nor a globally flat stage.

proof.text: Construct Aq, Bq and Nq by the explicit fraction functors primeRingDiagram and primeModuleDiagram. Naturality of η proves commutativity of the localized squares; primeModuleMap_smul proves semilinearity of the localized module transitions. Locality follows from Localization.isLocalHom_localRingHom.

Finite type over ℤ makes A_i Noetherian, and finite type over A_i makes B_i Noetherian. Their prime localizations are Noetherian local rings. Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule makes each localized D_i finite over its localized B_i.

Apply localized_approximation_colimits to the first six clauses of hmodel. It supplies ψ and the scalar action on the canonical localized module colimit, with the compatibility required by exists_flat_stage. Apply localizedModule_atPrime_of_flat to the given hflat and use the returned flatness equivalence to obtain flatness over the canonical localized base colimit.

Apply localized_approximation_baseChange to the transition tensor isomorphisms, converting preorder homomorphisms using leOfHom. Its conclusions are precisely hloc and hbase of RingTheory.exists_flat_stage. Apply that theorem to obtain an index i with Nq_i flat over Aq_i.

Set p_i=q∩B_i∩A_i. Give Nq_i its A_i action restricted through η_i and its (A_i)_{p_i} action restricted through the localRingHom. The localRingHom numerator formula and the algebraMap_smul formula prove these actions form a scalar tower. Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization then gives the required A_i-flatness. No limit tensor equivalence, openness, or persistence hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_finiteType_approximation_point
    (R S : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M]
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    (A B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (η : A ⟶ B)
      (π : A ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of R))
      (κ : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S))
      (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v})
      (ν : D ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))
    [∀ i : Λ, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)]
    (hmodel :
      -- (1) the three colimits, compatible with `R → S` and the module actions
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R) π)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S) κ)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (AddCommGrpCat.of M) ν)) ∧
      (∀ i, η.app i ≫ κ.app i = π.app i ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j) (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom (y • x) =
          (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      (∀ i (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) (y • x) =
          (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)) y •
            (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x) ∧
      -- (2) finiteness of the stages
      (∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType ℤ (A.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra; Algebra.FiniteType (A.obj i) (B.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Module.Finite (B.obj i) (D.obj i)) ∧
      -- (3) transition base changes
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (A.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j ≃+* B.obj j,
          ∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : A.obj j),
            e (x ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] y) = (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * (η.app j).hom y) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj j ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[B.obj j] D.obj j,
          ∀ (y : B.obj j) (x : D.obj i),
            e (y ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      -- (4) base changes to the limit
      (∀ i,
        letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of R) (π.app i)).toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] R ≃+* S,
          ∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : R),
            e (x ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] y) =
              (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)) x * algebraMap R S y) ∧
      (∀ i,
        letI := (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)).toAlgebra
        ∃ e : S ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[S] M,
          ∀ (y : S) (x : D.obj i),
            e (y ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = y • (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x))
    (hflat : letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap R S)
      Module.Flat R M) :
    ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S, ∃ i,
      letI : Module (A.obj i)
          (LocalizedModule (PrimeSpectrum.comap (κ.app i).hom q).asIdeal.primeCompl
            (D.obj i)) := Module.compHom _ (η.app i).hom
      Module.Flat (A.obj i)
        (LocalizedModule (PrimeSpectrum.comap (κ.app i).hom q).asIdeal.primeCompl
          (D.obj i))
